QF.id: XIII Trading, Clearing, Settlement and Risk Management_4

question.text: What is the ELM (Extreme Loss Margin) rate for USDINR futures contracts?

answer.text: 1% of the notional value of the gross open position
0.50% applied on the mark-to-market value of the gross open position
3.5% of the notional value of the gross open position
5% of the notional value of the gross open position

explanation.text: The Logic: Per the currency derivatives workbook, the ELM for USDINR futures is 0.50% and it is calculated on the mark-to-market value of the gross open position. ELM is charged in addition to SPAN/initial margin for all open positions. The Trap: 1% is not the source-supported USDINR futures ELM. 3.5% relates to certain equity stock margins. 5% is far above the prescribed currency rate. Also note that the base is mark-to-market value of gross open positions, not raw notional. Note: Total initial margin = SPAN/initial margin + ELM. The ELM is intended to cover losses outside the SPAN coverage on extreme moves.
